<h1><small>Stage 9 · Grandmaster · Lesson 2 of 6</small>Flash: ten 3-digit at 0.5 s</h1>
<div class="fields"><span>Name <u></u></span><span>Date <u class="s"></u></span><span>Time <u class="s"></u></span><span>Score <u class="s"></u> / 20</span><span class="pass">Pass: 15 of 20</span></div>
<div class="howto"><p><b>Today's move.</b> Half a second a number. The eyes stop reading and start seeing beads.</p><p><b>How.</b> A grown-up reads the numbers from page 2 at the beat. Keep the total in your head. Write it in the box.</p><p><b>Stuck?</b> If a round falls apart, let it go. Start fresh on the next one.</p></div>

<h1><small>Stage 9 · Grandmaster · Lesson 2</small>Flash: ten 3-digit at 0.5 s: read-aloud page</h1>
<div class="tempo"><p><b>The beat:</b> one number every 0.5 seconds. Set a free metronome app to 120 beats a minute and read one number on each beat. Say the numbers only, no "plus".</p><p><b>Too fast to read out loud?</b> It is, at this speed. Read the page at your quickest clear pace as a warm-up. Then run the true speed on the flash trainer in the app.</p><p>Say "that is" after the last number. Your child writes the total in the box with the same number. Do not repeat a number.</p></div>
